2. It lies in Arunachal Pradesh.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: Manas National Park is in Assam (Chirang and Baksa districts, Bodoland Territorial Region), in the Himalayan foothills along the Manas river. It was inscribed as a World Heritage Site in 1985, was on the List of World Heritage in Danger from 1992 to 2011, and borders Bhutan's Royal Manas National Park. It is also a tiger reserve, an elephant reserve and a biosphere reserve.

1. It is built across the Ganga in Murshidabad district of West Bengal.
2. Its feeder canal diverts Ganga water into the Bhagirathi-Hooghly, mainly to preserve Kolkata Port.
3. The project was dedicated to the nation in 1995.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: The Farakka Barrage is across the Ganga at Farakka in Murshidabad district (with parts in Malda), West Bengal. Its feeder canal diverts about 40,000 cusecs into the Bhagirathi-Hooghly system mainly to preserve Kolkata Port by flushing silt. The Farakka Barrage Project Authority was set up in 1961 and the project was dedicated to the nation in May 1975.

2. Sucre is its constitutional capital and the seat of the judiciary.
3. La Paz is the seat of its executive and legislative branches.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: Bolivia has a split capital: Sucre is the constitutional capital and seat of the judiciary, while La Paz houses the executive, legislative and electoral branches. Its currency is the boliviano (BOB).

Consider the following statements about the Swiss franc:
1. It is legal tender in Liechtenstein as well as in Switzerland.
2. Its ISO code CHF comes from 'Confoederatio Helvetica', the Latin name of Switzerland.
3. The Swiss National Bank, which issues its banknotes, has head offices in Zurich and Berne.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: The Swiss franc is the currency of Switzerland and Liechtenstein and is divided into 100 Rappen/centimes. Its ISO code CHF stands for Confoederatio Helvetica; Latin was chosen because Switzerland has four national languages. The Swiss National Bank holds the note-issuing privilege (coins are issued by Swissmint) and has head offices in Zurich and Berne.
solution.why_others_wrong: All three statements are supported by the sources.

2. Mysore State was renamed Karnataka on 1 November 1973.
3. Madras State was renamed Tamil Nadu in 1973.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: Kerala was formed on 1 November 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act, combining Travancore-Cochin (minus some southern taluks) with Malabar district and Kasaragod taluk of Madras State. Mysore State was renamed Karnataka on 1 November 1973 under the Mysore State (Alteration of Name) Act. Madras State was renamed Tamil Nadu on 14 January 1969.
